mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Have you ever noticed how, in the rush of leadership, we’re often expected to provide answers on the spot? But what if the real magic happens not when we talk, but when we pause—and ask the right question? That’s the journey we’re about to take together, inspired by Michael Bungay Stanier’s insightful book, The Coaching Habit: Say Less, Ask More & Change the Way You Lead Forever. We’ll explore how shifting from telling to asking can spark genuine transformation—not just in teams, but in ourselves as leaders. Imagine leading with curiosity, listening more deeply, and guiding others to uncover their own answers. That’s exactly what we’ll dive into: practical, easy-to-use strategies and the seven powerful questions that can turn any conversation into a moment of growth. Together, we’ll discover how leadership isn’t about top-down authority, but about building trust, inspiring innovation, and making every interaction count. So, if you’re ready to change the way you lead—one question at a time—let’s get started on this journey.
